descriptionEn:
서연이 and 혜린이 were the first two revealed while living at Gapyeong HAUS,
and before the taller S members debuted, these two shorter members got this cute chemistry name.

They're the only Queendom Puzzle (survival) alumni in tripleS, so
fans had been calling them Queendomz, but
while hosting 240902 Adola MC they referred to each other as 계란즈.
As for why 계란즈 — on the 230614 SIGNAL LIVE,
서연이 wore yellow and 지우 wore white, so they decided on 계란즈 that day.
(Looking back at the 230614 SIGNAL LIVE, they tried to pick a chemistry name but never settled on one and
kind of glossed over it — but the two of them seem to remember it as 계란즈.)

A chemistry name given because both have puppy-like looks.
From baby dog sounds: 김채연 is 뭉뭉,
and 윤서연 looks like she'd go 망망.

Chosen through a WAV fan vote.

photo by. @posh1204

On the 220901 live, chemistry name candidates like '뽀얀즈, 토끼즈' came up, and then 서연이 said she wanted to be a bunny too — so since both have fair skin and are bunny-like, they combined the two into '뽀토즈'.

After 뽀토즈 appeared, it naturally became 뽀냥즈 with cat-like 김나경.
They mentioned it themselves on 241226 SIGNAL LIVE, making it official.

The third spin-off of 뽀토즈: '밤' comes from 유빈이's nickname 유밤이,
and '뽀' could mean fair-skinned ('뽀'얗다) or Pochacco ('뽀'차코).
Fans coined this because 서연이 and 카에데's faces look soft and round like soft rice cakes (물떡).

햄햄다즈 is a cute chemistry name blending 서연이's nickname '햄햄' and 다현이's '다' after Häagen-Dazs ice cream. 열일즈 comes from reading 다현's number S10 in Korean as '열' and 서연이's S1 as '일' — together 열일즈, which also doubles as shorthand for '열심히 일을 한다' (working hard). Since they both work so hard, Seoyeon really liked it, and on 250909 SIGNAL LIVE they decided to use both 햄햄다즈 and 열일즈. Fans will probably stick with 햄햄다즈 more though.

서연이 and 코토네's reveal numbers are made only of 1s — S1 and S11 — so the 1s look like Pepero sticks, hence 빼빼로즈.

Shared via 240117 Kotone Fromm

Combines the 햄 from hamster (the animal 서연이 resembles) and puppy/멍멍이 (the animal 니엔 resembles). Overseas WAVs tend to use Sunnyz more than 햄멍즈 though.

Confirmed on 250330 Seoyeon's Fromm
When WAVs asked how the two got close, 서연이 said she and 소현이 became close quickly because they're each other's bias. A chemistry name born from being each other's favorites.
Named on 230913 SIGNAL LIVE because 윤서연 and 저우신위 share the same Korean initials 'ㅇㅅㅇ'.

서연이 and 시온이 are both from Daejeon and love bread, so the name shortens '빵을 냠냠먹다' (nom-nomming bread).

Decided on 240126 SIGNAL LIVE.
A chemistry name and unit name made on 250210 SIGNAL. Supposedly a two-person YouTuber(?) duo of Natural Monument No. 1 Reusable Plastic Bag (윤서연) and Fairy Who Only Got Ground (김채원).
In tripleS they're S1 and S24, and their full names are both Seoyeon — 윤서연 and 지서연 — so their chemistry name became 서연즈.

On 220726 SIGNAL, 혜린이 and 유연이 were taking Japanese lessons together when 유연이 mistook '수고 많았다' for '스고이' and kept answering everything with 스고이 — from that lesson day on, they became 스고이즈.
On the 250929 COSMO voice-only live, 혜린이 forgot 스고이즈 even existed, so they might pick a new name; current top candidates are (25즈 and 심장이 유혜).
photo by. @triplesbburing
혜린이 and 수민이 are both from Daegu, so they're called 대구즈.
혜린이 and 유빈이 were roommates at Namsan HAUS and, noting how big both their eyes are, coined the chemistry name '왕눈즈'.

카에데's name in Korean uses '단' from maple (단풍) and '네' from 혜린이's nickname 리네, swapped to 내, forming the Korean dialect phrase 단내 난다 meaning '달달한 냄새가 난다' (smells sweet) — a punny chemistry name that 혜린이 herself set on the 250811 SIGNAL.
They told a story on 230405 SIGNAL LIVE about a kid at a neighborhood playground calling 혜린이 and 다현이 '이모들' (aunties) — that's when this name stuck.
Used when Hyerin posted a selfie taken by Tone on the official SNS on 250317. Likely from Hyerin's nickname 리네 and Kotone.
Combines the '소' from 소현 and the '리' from 혜린이's nickname 리네. Made on 231117 Park Sohyun's Fromm.

A chemistry name coined by 자몽샤베트 on 250210 SIGNAL.
혜린이 and 신위 said they often go shopping together and have matching tastes.

260412 SIGNAL LIVE — set on 혜린이 and 린's birthday SIGNAL LIVE — combining '샤' from 샤메 (Japanese for shark) and '냥' from 고양이를 귀엽게 부르는 냥냥이. They like the sharp vibe of 웨이브를 사냥하겠다 (hunting WAVs). (Temporary chemistry name)
정혜린 and 정하연 are the same age and were the only Jeong members in the team until 서아(정해린) was revealed, so they got this name.
They got close as roommates sharing the mint room at Gapyeong HAUS, and were later also called 민트방즈.
Already knew each other before joining the group from appearing on 방과후 설렘 (R U Next?); they faced off as competitors on that show's semifinal stage performing Léon together.
On 220819 SIGNAL, they combined '데니스트' — from 수민이 mispronouncing Destiny to 유연이 — with the 'Death Note' necklace 지우 wanted in New York but never got, settling on '데니즈'.

Before joining Modhaus they trained together as actor trainees at JYP. On 220701 SIGNAL, when asked 'Is there a friend around you who could become a new S?', Lee Jiwoo said yes — and later revealed she was thinking of Gong Yubin. One of the most famous chemistries in tripleS.

Via 260322 Kotone Fromm, it means 쥬(지우) and 또네(토네),
and also sounds like Japanese ずっと (ずっと / zutto, forever), so they went with it.

Mixing their signature colors makes light green (연두), and both have that fresh, youthful vibe.
12(연지) 3(지우) 123 — numbers that '연'connect as '두' people.

Chosen through a WAV fan vote.
지우's '우' and 마유's '유' combined into this chemistry name.

While chatting on 250511 Jiyeon Fromm they said 'secret' as 지크릿, and a WAV brought up chiriring-chiriring 지크릿 쥬쥬.
So 지연이 liked it, told 지우, and it became 지크릿쥬쥬즈.

Named because both have peach-like looks. Chaeyeon's emblem emoji is also a peach.
[As of 2025 Chaeyeon came to dislike peaches, so it was changed to a deer emoji.]
김채연 looks like My Melody and 김나경 looks like Kuromi, so their chemistry name became 마멜즈.

채연이 and 유빈이 host All The K-Pop's
Dream Center Study Room as MCs, hence the name.

At a past Disney princess fansign, 김채연 and 카에데 went as Elsa (채연이) and Anna (카에데), and decided oo즈 is overdone — let's go with Frozen.
photo by. annyeongsubsubs
Combines the old show Boni Hani that 채연이 hosted with 코토네's name. 코토네 collected candidates via Fromm, asked 채연이, and locked it in.
Combines '연' from 김채연 and '엔' from 니엔 — also a double meaning for 연예인 (celebrity).
채연's '연' and 마유's '유' combined into this chemistry name.

On 251224 COSMO Live they said they look prettier with bangs up showing their foreheads, so they started calling themselves 이마즈.
Originally on 241031 SIGNAL LIVE they used 비스니즈 because they were awkward and business-like, but they got much closer over the year and seem to have made a new name.

During Girls Never Die promotions, in The Show waiting room 하연이 made a kissing motion at 채연이 — and 채연 didn't dodge, so they accidentally kissed.
On 240716 SIGNAL LIVE, 하연 recalled closing her eyes for the fake kiss and being surprised by how moist (촉촉) it felt, proposing the chemistry name 촉촉즈.
Originally '김채즈' because both have 김채 in their names, but they said they're matcha mates and newly changed it to 말차즈. Mentioned on 250621 SIGNAL.
Decided on 240814 SIGNAL LIVE  . Combines '연' from 채연 and '락' from 설린's Thai real name 피라다 분락사.
Named because both love strawberry latte. There's a hidden anecdote that they like each other mutually.

The combo of February-born 김유연 and October-born 김나경.
They also used 투텐즈 when co-hosting as special DJs on 241028 Idol Live / IDOL RADIO. One of the most famous chemistries in tripleS.
유연이 and 유빈이 both have '유' in their names, hence the combo name.

In the Hit the Floor choreography there's a section right after the verse-2 chorus where both 김유연 and 카에데 exit to stage left,
and at fansigns they always hug in that part — so fans went '나안아~' and the chemistry name was born.
김유연 later made it official via Fromm.
Photo by @Sharon_0209

They needed a new chemistry name for 유연이 and 토네, but kept putting it off every time they tried, so on 250418 Kotone Fromm fans suggested 미룬즈. Yooyeon checked and liked it, so it became official.
photo by. @yume040310
From first impressions: 박소현 looks cool/cold and 김유연 looks warm, so they got 냉온즈.

In a Girls Never Die MV filming behind video, wearing the same clothes and similar hairstyles,
people said they looked like twins, and the subtitle used the chemistry name 쌍둥이즈.
유연 and 마유 are tripleS's representative bunny visuals — 유연이 the big bunny, 마유 the little bunny — so they're called 토끼즈. Some fans also use 마유연.

tripleS's oldest (유연) and maknae (서아) became 맏막즈.
(The maknae slot for 맏막즈 has changed three times: 연지 -> 주빈-> 서아.)
Photo by. @s23_Seah
A WAV-picked chemistry name — both look soft and squishy (말랑말랑).

During Seongsu HAUS days, while live, WAVs asked what chemistry name they wanted, and Soomin said she'd just eaten potato stew (감자탕) before the live
so they'd go with 감자탕즈.
(See 221129 SIGNAL LIVE)

Uses '수' from Kim Soomin and '다' from Seo Dahyun. Named on SIGNAL LIVE because the two talk a lot.
photo by @soomsoomsoom103

At a 251129 Hachi event a WAV asked Soomin for their chemistry name and she answered 타코야끼즈.
Both have round faces; asked who handles which part, Tone is the takoyaki and Soomin is the '즈'.
photo by. Kotoworld0310
When they're together it's legendary, so Soomin said on Fromm they'd name the chemistry 레전드.

On 240807 Joobin Fromm, asked if she had a chemistry name with Soomin, she mentioned 잭과콩나뭉즈 — Soomin is 'Jack' and Joobin is '콩나뭉'; she said she doesn't know why the '뭉'. Soomin named it herself, but a year later she forgot and only Joobin remembers — a one-sided crush chemistry(?). Confirmable on 250913 Joobin Fromm.
Photo by. DoNot_S6

Combines ' зовні' (short for Chaewon's nickname Alien) and '숨' (short for Soomin).
Started as a fans-only name, but now so many fans use it that it's basically official.

On 230316 SIGNAL, seeing the two assigned to the relatively empty Yeouido HAUS,
Kim Yooyeon joked that they were being put in isolation,
and after that everyone except the two themselves — members and fans — called them 격리즈.

Uses '나' from Kim Nakyoung and '다' from Seo Dahyun.
They failed ceremonial first pitch/first hit for the Lotte Giants twice right in front of them (rainout, heat cancel),
but on 250816 they finally did it.
**250816 롯데vs삼성**
Combines 나(낫)경 and Ko토네. Kotone shared it via Fromm.

밤양갱 + '냥' from kitty + '갱' from puppy,
Also used when the two co-hosted as special DJs on IDOL RADIO in September 2024.

Members with the exact same birth year, month, and day.
On 241226 SIGNAL LIVE they said they both forget things easily, so the chemistry name was made.
But to dress it up they said it's '깜' from 깜냥이 and '박' from Teacher Park.
Combines '키' from Nakyoung's nickname 나키 and '위' from Xinyu.

Kim Nakyoung is S7 and Lynn is S17, so they became 칠칠즈.
photo by. april_s17

First mentioned on Hayeon's Fromm; they said unexpected situations keep overlapping for them — 'We're destiny (필연)!'
— and that's how the name was born.

Combines Nakyoung's nickname '나키' and '지' from Jiyeon. Mentioned on 250124 Nakyoung Fromm,
wrapped up with 'I'll ask Jiyeon,' then made official when Jiyeon mentioned it at the 260208 fansign.
photo by. wavv57

Kaede means maple (단풍), so '단' + '밤' from Yubin's nickname 유밤.
photo by.OvO_ple

Baby tiger Yubin and baby wolf-cat Yeonji — both little beasts that go 캬옹.
(Not an official chemistry name; chosen via a Yeonji fan-account vote.)
photo by. Compexity_12
On 240229 Yubin Fromm, a fan asked for the chemistry name with Joobin and she said Joobin liked 공주즈, so that stuck. photo by. Bin_C1ndy_u
Named on 250612 SIGNAL LIVE, taking one syllable each from 공유빈 and 정하연.
Combines '설' from Sullin and '밤' from Yubin's nickname 유밤. Yubin mentioned it herself in the 250813 concert behind SIGNAL, and again later on Yubin Fromm.

Whether good or bad, they always go through the same things together and keep ending up paired when groups are split,
so it became '원플원즈' short for 'one plus one'.

Very close after rooming together ~5 months in Seongsu HAUS's blue room.
Check the **official video** for a chemistry compilation.

Officially labeled '카토네,' but on **230412 SIGNAL LIVE** they said they didn't like that and took one 'ㅋ' from each name to make 'ㅋㅋ즈'.
On 240909 Fromm Kotone complained again about the company calling them 카토네 and
clearly restated that the chemistry name is 'ㅋㅋ즈'.
At a fansign a WAV wrote on a sticky note asking Yeonji what chemistry name she wanted with Kaede — she wrote she wanted 동글즈.
Takes '니' from Nien and '카' from Kaede; mixes Chinese (你) and Japanese (可愛い) to match their nationalities.
Combines '소' from Sohyun and '풍' from maple (단풍), Kaede's meaning. Photo by. kaede_noway

Takes '마' from Mayu and '카' from Kaede; made on **230726 SIGNAL LIVE**.
photo by. manimanihus_o0
Takes '냐' each from Kaede's iconic line '**안 봤냐?**' and Park Shion's '**날겠냐?**' from Badge War 2; made on 250218 SIGNAL LIVE.

Named because their personal fandoms are '소다단' and '콜라단'; coined by Kotone.
photo by. lovewav
Combines Seo Dahyun's signature nickname '소다' and Park Sohyun's name '소현'.

From the 2024 Chuseok SIGNAL where they named a team with Sullin '야무지,' they almost went with '무지즈,'
but that sounded too clueless (무지), so they flipped it to '지능즈' on 241025 SIGNAL LIVE.

The official main vocal combo — both took main vocal on their first activities after reveal.
photo by. Tiramisu0403
Combines Chaewon's emblem emoji 'strawberry' and Dahyun's nickname '소다'; set on **240830 SIGNAL LIVE**.

From 다현 어린이 and 설린 어린이 — named because they both have kid-like sides.
On **260119 SIGNAL** Dahyun insisted it must start with '닿'.
Decided via 250423 SIGNAL. Combines '서' from Seah and '소' from Dahyun's nickname 소다.

Named because both lived at Tokyo HAUS. Challenges they've done as 도쿄즈:
**2023**,**2024**,**2025**, **2026**. (Song: Love On Top)
From the Japanese greeting 곤니치와, blending Kotone's 코 and Nien's 니 into a hello-style name. A 코니치와 greeting appears early in the 230526 SIGNAL. Chemistry name made by Nien herself.

Kotone guested on Park Sohyun's solo 230515 SIGNAL LIVE and they hosted together.
Named literally because both members have low voices.

They used to love Gong Cha but Mayu graduated from it so Gongchaz never formed and disbanded,
yet they still drink bubble tea often and love the tapioca pearls in it — so they settled on '타피즈'.
Used when Hyerin posted a selfie taken by Tone on the official SNS on 250317. Likely from Hyerin's nickname 리네 and 코토네.

Per their own claim they're dumpling-faced; made on 240709 SIGNAL LIVE. Kotone is boiled dumpling, Joobin is steamed dumpling.
Kotone always says on Fromm that Joobin is her bias among the members.
photo by. Kotoworld0310

Named on 251116 COSMO Live.
Combines Shion's nickname 숀 and Kotone's signature cola into 숀콜라.
photo by. tipleS_S14_fan
Combines '코' from Kotone and '채' from Chaewon. The chemistry name is '코챌라' without the usual ~즈.

The sound of imitating Pingu's voice. Jiyeon is good at it,
and Kotone loves Pingu impressions so they made it the chemistry name.
Like '눕눕' being the same front and back, the two have very similar tastes — Kotone is 눕1, Jiyeon is 눕2.
**(케미 참고 영상)**

Combines '엔' from Nien and '지' from Yeonji.
On 260320 SIGNAL, at Sohyun's suggestion, Sohyun and Nien named it themselves. photo by. @0108_biscuit

Said to combine Joobin's nickname 콩 (bean) and Yeonji's duck (덕).
(Not an official chemistry name; chosen via a Yeonji fan-account vote.)

From hedgehog (고슴도'치') Hayeon meeting '초'월소녀 Yeonji, plus the ㄱ from 귀엽다 (cute).
(Not an official chemistry name; chosen via a Yeonji fan-account vote.)
photo by. YH_S12S19
At the 240803 fansign their fansign item was Sugar Sugar Rune's Vanilla Chocolat, so they mentioned 슈가즈.
Their numbers are S12 and S24, which evokes December 24 (Christmas Eve), so it became 이브즈.

Nien herself named it on **230425 SIGNAL**.
Takes '박' from Park Sohyun and '쉬' from Nien's real name 쉬니엔츠.

The only two Greater China members in the group. Already knew each other from Girls Planet 999,
and even met in Korea without knowing they were both little S's.

Combines '하' from Hayeon and '니' from Nien.
Mentioned in the 250429 Chwak Chwak Blood performance filming behind SIGNAL.
Combines '니' from Nien, '온' from Shion, and the fact that both love bread.

Mentioned in the **250514** Wake showcase behind SIGNAL.
Both had 똥머리 (hair buns), so they were called 똥 sisters, then asked each other if they like poop… and 똥똥즈 was formed.
photo by. madebykenny

Combines Sohyun's '소' and Xinyu's '신'.
Made without deep meaning, but still one of the most famous chemistries in tripleS.
Combines 소현 and 리네; made on 231117 Park Sohyun's Fromm.
A combo of S members with the surname Park; inspired by the swallow bringing a 'gourd seed (박씨)' in Heungbu Jeon. photo by. boang_9424

Combines '소' from Sohyun and '설' from Sullin.
Brought up on 25.10.25 Sohyun Fromm — they'd go with it if Sullin liked it,
and Sullin did, so it became 소설즈.
photo by. Plumver1130
Made via Seah's Fromm: 햇님 is Seah, 달님 is Park Sohyun.

Inspired on 240724 SIGNAL LIVE; refers to Xinyu and Chaewon having a lot to hide.
(Also a chemistry born from flirting with other members even though each already has a famous partner chemistry.)
Combines 마유 and 시온; set on 240806 SIGNAL LIVE.
Because their hair colors are blue and pink like Sanrio characters Kiki and Lala.
The only two members in the group with single-syllable given names.
Combines 하연 and 린(인).

Because they seem completely harmless and wouldn't hurt anyone.
If either of them causes harm it could become 유해즈(?).

Named for sounding like 'Soaring,' the Tokyo DisneySea attraction.
Fans suggested it on Seah's Fromm,
and Lynn accepted it as the official chemistry name.

On 251114 Lynn's COSMO Live she said she'd just set a chemistry name with Jiyeon unnie.
잠미즈 means 'sleepy beauties.' Not official then — she said it was temporary.
Then **260105 SIGNAL** showed them deciding on 잠미즈,
and even though it was temporary, they keep using it when they meet so it seems to have stuck as official.

On SIGNAL LIVE their dynamic was compared to Tom and Jerry, so they named it 톰과제리즈.
Tom is Jeong Hayeon; Jerry is Joobin.
Combines '주' from Joobin and '시온' from Park Shion; they made it themselves on 240112 SIGNAL LIVE.

First mentioned on 260316 Chaewon Fromm, then again on 260320 Joobin's COSMO Live.
Seems to combine 빈 as '콩' (bean) and Chaewon's emblem '갸루' into 콩가루 as their combo name 콩갸루즈.
설린 + 주빈(빙). Joobin made it herself via Fromm, and Sullin later accepted it as official.

Combines Seah's sun emblem and Joobin's 빈 meaning bean into 햇콩즈.
The maknae and the S right above her by age;
despite being a maknae pair, chemistry was hard to find until after the world tour when it started showing a lot.

Both have cheeks that stretch like mochi, plus a pun on 'can't tear them apart' (못찢).
Set on **240409** SIGNAL LIVE.
One of the most famous chemistries in tripleS.

Combines '눈' from Sullin's tsundere and '온' from Shion — meaning 'it's snowing,'
and if Dahyun joins too it becomes 눈온다즈.

Combines '설' from Sullin and '원' from Chaewon.
(Not an official chemistry name; chosen via a Sullin fan-account vote.)
photo by. @Plumver1130
The combo of the last two members revealed, combining stage names proposed by CEO Jung Byung-ki from Gravity. Made on 240416 SIGNAL LIVE; they also made the shortened name 끌레도즈.
